newsitem.title: USA: Value Health jumps after acqusition news.
newsitem.headline: Value Health jumps after acqusition news.

text.p: Value Health Inc shares jumped onto the top percentage-gainers list in early New York Stock Exchange trade Wednesday, up nearly seven percent after it agreed to buy a workers' compensation managed care company.
Before the market open, Beverly Enterprises Inc said it will sell its MedView Services unit to Value Health Inc for $87.5 million cash.
Beverly shares edged up 1/8 to 10-7/8, also on the NYSE.
MedView provides managed care services to the workers' compensation market and is the nation's largest workers' compensation-related preferred provider organization, with 120,000 member providers.
It also offers case management and injury reporting/tracking services.
Beverly the sale of MedView will not have a material effect on its fourth quarter pretax income from ongoing operations, which is expected to meet management's internal profit plan.
